Nadia (Docs): Quick note: during v1->v2 migration guide edits I spotted an embed alias swap that changes vector dim (1024 -> 1536) and can break indexes.
Eli (SDK): Can you add a minimal, truncated repro and a simple dim-check snippet we can copy into SDK docs?
Nadia (Docs): Truncated repro:
POST /v2/embeddings body:{\"model\":\"alias:embed-stable\",\"input\":\"hi\"} response:{\"data\": [{\"embedding\": [...1536 floats...]}]}
Rohit (Product): Product requests a short banner and a 3-step recipe: 1) sample 1k queries, 2) verify dims, 3) pin model or reindex.
Eli (SDK): Proposed snippet for docs (language-agnostic):
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    raise RuntimeError(\"embedding size mismatch; pin model version or reindex\")
infra-bot: created task DOCS-2001 embed-dim-migration assigned to @Nadia,@Eli,@Rohit due in 10 days.)
